column2: Fotofoto - FOTOFOTO "Iris" | Sustainable Disposable Camera
column3:
Meet FOTOFOTO, the "disposable" camera made out of 100% trash. 

WINNER, 2024 Red Dot Design Award

1. 100% TRASH — Every FOTOFOTO camera is made from up-cycled waste, and each one gets recycled over and over. And over.

2. AUTOMATIC XENON FLASH — Ever taken photos on a dispo and some came out blank? Same. FOTOFOTO's automatic flash ensures all your photos will be better lit, with *zero* blanks.

3. CINEMA-GRADE COLOR FILM — Last night was a movie—and will look like it, too. By using the same film stock as Hollywood cinematographers, FOTOFOTO photos have richer and deeper color than other disposables.

4. PAY-LATER DEVELOPING — Send your camera back to us when you're done and we’ll develop your photos at our lab. Choose to get scans, prints or both.

5. CIRCULAR – when we receive your camera back for developing, we refurbish and recycle it, sending it back out into the world to make more memories.

It's time to #ditchyourdispo.

In Sweden, salty candy is considered as a culinary delicacy.

These twists are the perfect blend of soft, chewy, salty and sweet. Perfect inside a Easter gifting basket.
